newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-BEARDSLEY FINALLY MOVES TO BOLTON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BEARDSLEY FINALLY MOVES TO BOLTON.

text.p: Former England striker Peter Beardsley finally left Newcastle for Bolton on Monday in a 450,000 pounds ($724,000) deal.
The 36-year-old was due to move two weeks ago but the transfer was put on hold after Alan Shearer suffered a serious ankle injury.
The setback came after the sale of Les Ferdinand to Tottenham and left Newcastle short of firepower.
But last week's purchase of John Barnes and Ian Rush meant Newcastle could afford to let Beardsley go.
